1.3 Kaplan-Meier Analysis

1.3.1 Fitting the Kaplan-Meier Estimator

# Fit KM curves by treatment group
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = aml)

summary(km_fit)

plot(km_fit)







library(ggsurvfit)

ggsurvfit(km_fit)







survfit2(Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = aml) |>
  ggsurvfit(linewidth = 1) +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  add_risktable() +
  add_quantile(y_value = 0.6, color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_ggsurvfit()










1.3.2 Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves

# Extract KM estimates into a tidy data frame for plotting
km_df <- data.frame(
  time   = km_fit$time,
  surv   = km_fit$surv,
  lower  = km_fit$lower,
  upper  = km_fit$upper,
  group  = rep(names(km_fit$strata), km_fit$strata)
)

ggplot(km_df, aes(x = time, y = surv, colour = group)) +
  geom_step() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (weeks)",
    y = "Survival probability",
    colour = "Treatment",
    fill = "Treatment",
    title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()

Warning: Removed 1 row containing missing values or values outside the scale range
(`geom_ribbon()`).











1.3.3 Log-Rank Test

# Test whether survival differs between groups
logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = aml)

logrank_test

Call:
survdiff(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = aml)

                 N Observed Expected (O-E)^2/E (O-E)^2/V
x=Maintained    11        7    10.69      1.27       3.4
x=Nonmaintained 12       11     7.31      1.86       3.4

 Chisq= 3.4  on 1 degrees of freedom, p= 0.07

2.2 Survival Objects
Turning time to event data into a ‘survival’ object witht he Surv() function.

with(aml, Surv(time = time, event = status))

 [1]   9   13   13+  18   23   28+  31   34   45+  48  161+   5    5    8    8 
[16]  12   16+  23   27   30   33   43   45 



2.2.1 Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves
Normally this is wrapped in another function. Here we use the survfit() function to fit a survival curve.

km <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = aml) 

Gives us survival summary stats at various time points.

summary(km)

Call: survfit(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = aml)

We can specify a time point we care about, for example, 30-day survival.

summary(km, times = 30)

Call: survfit(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = aml)

 time n.risk n.event survival std.err lower 95% CI upper 95% CI
   30      9      12    0.442    0.11        0.272        0.718


Plot a Kaplam-Meier curve

plot(km)








We can do this manually with ggplot2::geom_step()

km_df <- data.frame(
  time   = km$time,
  surv   = km$surv,
  lower  = km$lower,
  upper  = km$upper
)

ggplot(km_df, aes(x = time, y = surv)) +
  geom_step() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
